title: SHMtrace: control-calibrated profiling of somatic hypermutation
description: SHMtrace measures somatic hypermutation from amplicon reads on any platform (nanopore, PacBio, Illumina, Sanger) by testing each candidate mutation against the errors of matched AID-null libraries from the same run, with a control-based false-discovery threshold and animal-level group tests. Includes a desktop application.
